children.name: Smilax tetraptera Schltr.
children.description: Notes: Smilax tetraptera was described by Schlechter (1906) based on his collection made from the mountains of Ngoye, New Caledonia in November 1902 having the collection number 15207 as specified in the protologue. While searching for the original material, three sheets were found associated with S. tetraptera, one each at B (B 100365950), K (K 000820870), and P (P 00537836).
